name: What is the process for water damage restoration in a restaurant?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for water damage restoration in a restaurant?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restoration process typically begins with an emergency call and a rapid assessment of the damage. Professionals will then extract standing water using powerful equipment. This is followed by thorough drying and dehumidification to remove all moisture from the structure and contents. Cleaning, sanitizing, and deodorizing affected areas are next, preventing mold and bacteria growth. Finally, any necessary repairs or reconstruction are performed to return your restaurant to its pre-damage condition, minimizing interruption to your operations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves emergency assessment, water extraction, drying and dehumidification, cleaning, sanitizing, and final repairs.
